gold_decisions.identity_explanation: The gold concerns a malformed local-to-global dG-star interpolation estimate: the seminorm ranges over the mesh while the interpolant and right-hand side are local. ISSUE-001 instead diagnoses insufficient time regularity for applying Picard–Lindelöf to the semidiscrete ODE. These are different mathematical objects and failed obligations.

Both identify that the semidiscrete well-posedness proposition applies classical Picard–Lindelöf and claims C2 pressure/C1 concentration despite source terms assumed only in L2 in time. Both also identify the resulting loss of the claimed classical regularity and the need for continuous-in-time data or weaker solution spaces.
